name: PhenoSpecs
description: Central specification registry for Phenotype ADRs, API contracts, templates, and traceability data
rationale: AGENTS.md defines PhenoSpecs as the canonical language-agnostic spec template and ADR/contract spine. README documents the four-role governance split: phenotype-registry owns the ecosystem index while PhenoSpecs owns ADRs, API contracts, and specs. Its source and history remain distinct; registry.yaml is a spec-to-implementation traceability index, not a replacement for this repository.

prior_claim.reason: Current repository remains public, active, and explicitly assigned the ADRs/contracts role; no parity, migration, or source-history merge proof was found.
